previous_statement: For every homogeneous a in I, sigma^*(a) is congruent to -a modulo I^2; therefore the map induced by sigma^* on I/I^2 is -id.
new_statement: In the identity of node 1.2, every aPrime_j and aDoublePrime_j lies in I, and node 1.1 gives sigma^*(aPrime_j) in I; hence every product sigma^*(aPrime_j)aDoublePrime_j lies in I^2. Thus sigma^*(a) is congruent to -a modulo I^2 for each homogeneous a in I, and by homogeneous decomposition and linearity sigma^* induces -id on all of I/I^2.
